piece.headline: PALMER ARMBAND RETURNS -2, NIKHIL STILL LEADS THE LEAGUE
piece.standfirst: Nikhil takes top spot from Ravin, Naresh posts the week's best score and 12 managers kept faith with Haaland.
piece.big_picture: Nikhil takes top spot from Ravin and sits 8 clear of Chandru. His Palmer armband returned -2. Chandru climbs to 2nd. Ravin falls to 5th. The chase is on.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Nikhil, Sahil and Hishaan all captained Palmer instead of Haaland. Palmer returned -2 with the armband. Haaland would have given 16.
piece.one_to_watch: Deepak and Ravin are 1 point apart at the Gold spots line. A gap that small could swing either way next week.

winners.name: Naresh
winners.verdict: Best score in the league. The captain blanked and he still won the week. Tavernier came in.

winners.name: Vinesh
winners.verdict: White and Tavernier in, +15 on the swap. Transfer Genius, and the table agrees: up 5 places.

winners.name: Ravi Mahtani
winners.verdict: Tavernier in, Haaland captained, up to 12th. 2 sound calls, both rewarded.

losers.name: Pishu
losers.verdict: João Pedro got the armband and blanked. Down 6 places to 22nd. A tough one to shake off.

losers.name: Ravin
losers.verdict: Lost top spot after a João Pedro armband that returned nothing. Now 5th.

losers.name: Hishaan
losers.verdict: Palmer got the armband over Haaland and returned -2. Down to 23rd. One to shrug off.
